value: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five photos of the same pet, choose a watercolor, royal or studio style, and download a digital portrait. The Starter Pack costs $4.99 for 12 non-expiring credits. Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations use no credits. Pro subscriptions provide 40 credits per month. Portraits together and photo cleanup are beta features. Faces, markings and fine details may vary. Digital downloads only, no physical prints.
